mapper.insert: INSERT INTO andon_type (type_name, type_code, handle_mode, light_color, description) VALUES (#{typeName}, #{typeCode}, #{handleMode}, #{lightColor}, #{description})
mapper.update:
UPDATE andon_type
type_name = #{typeName}, type_code = #{typeCode}, handle_mode = #{handleMode}, light_color = #{lightColor}, description = #{description},
WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE andon_type SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM andon_type WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

AND (type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR type_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
